journey: anomaly -> summoned body -> evidence -> repair (an observed anomaly summons a body through the action surface; the repair is evidence-gated)

scenario.test_name: the repair is EVIDENCE-GATED and the timeline records every step

revisions.head_note: implementation_head is the lane-branch commit containing the suite sources and these evidence records; the finalization follow-up commit (evidence-only) records it. The architect gate binds to the branch head.

evidence_graph_links: the anomaly is OBSERVED by the no-body plane: a scripted ci.run FAILURE envelope on the observed head 86a6921631113167f071c2f9019dddd0c1ab6447 yields detection CI_FAILING_ON_HEAD (SHORTFALL) with non-empty evidenceEventIds — and still zero leases (observation detects, it does not summon)

the summon goes THROUGH the P9 action surface: startTask grants the body-lifecycle lease via the gateway with action-time authority re-evaluation (every evaluation GRANTED); the durable lease binds the observed head sha; the gateway action log records action.succeeded for the body-lifecycle family

the repair is evidence-gated: completion is granted only from the durable transcript by the independent verifier (the runtime never certifies itself); the task record ends COMPLETED with final_verification.verified and non-empty evidence_refs

the timeline records every step: the task timeline replays with checkpoint + completion categories, and the repair's own observations.emit event (p15b.anomaly-repair.executed with anomaly CI_FAILING_ON_HEAD) lands durably in the observation store
the task node carries mission_ref + authority_ref end-to-end and ends COMPLETED with a verification_ref
negative pin: with the runtime actor's body-lifecycle grant revoked, the SAME anomaly summons NOTHING (typed DENIED, zero leases, no repair observation emitted)
retained_uncertainty: the anomaly source is a scripted CI envelope (simulated) — no real CI bus is connected; the detection is deterministic over reference events
the repair body is a reference CloudCodingShellBody simulator; its workspace writes land in the deterministic in-memory fabric, not a real filesystem
the independent verifier of this journey is the deterministic transcript verifier (reference fidelity); the product's independent evaluation suite is exercised by the flagship journey record
